method.cost: One hidden-width parameter vector per new arm, with elementwise operations over [batch, length, hidden]. GPU runtime is unmeasured. Reserve full frozen-protocol fits and confirmation overhead in the proposal budget.
method.mechanism: Agent hypothesis. Add a zero-initialized learnable feature vector g to each arm. Keep the incumbent output intact, then add 0.1 × tanh(g) × compressed_current in the candidate. The generated control adds 0.1 × tanh(g) × compressed_preceding_context only where a predecessor exists. Both use the same parameter count, initialization, coefficient, and final valid-token mask. Zero initialization makes each arm equal the incumbent before learning; a nonuniform gain distinguishes current-state calibration from context calibration.
